audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all eight Leah cabin event records, including sculpture responses, the art-show and online-shop branches, the conversation about Kel, and follow-up dialogue. Every line, embedded question, response option, conditional and gender branch, art and web term, and Leah’s reflective voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Leah, Pelican Town and Stardew Valley terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship changes, response IDs, placeholders, runtime gender selector, branch delimiters, emotion markers, sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. One intentional silent reaction is explicitly preserved. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
